citations.assessment: The passage directly names Rav Kahana son of Rav Ḥinena the Elder as the reciter of the ruling on bread baked with roasting meat.

holds.raw: תלמיד שמואל. לא מצאתי שיהיה תלמיד שמואל
holds.reason: The recitation does not establish discipleship. Retain the reported designation and Heilprin’s express nonfinding with their separate force.
The similarly named Rabbah in entry 3198 is described as a disciple of Rav Yehudah; the exact Rav transmission and identity with this son remain unconfirmed.
